arxiv-zotero-obsidian 1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Automatically scans arxiv.drqyq.com for new papers in specified categories.
- Adds newly found papers to a chosen Zotero collection, avoiding duplicates.
- Generates structured reading notes in Obsidian using a detailed template.
- Supports configuration for arXiv category, Zotero and Obsidian integration, scheduling, and more.
